name: Period, XBRL and Accounting Controls
required_scope: Use first-run failures to strengthen quarter, YTD, FY, LTM, instant versus flow, unit, currency, share count, non-calendar fiscal year, 53-week fiscal year, negative denominator, and missing XBRL-tag controls.
Place every analytical implementation change in the shared Data and Evidence Layer.

scope_ownership.downstream_integration: build_public_company_investment_layer.py deletes duplicate fact-selection, share-count, FY/YTD, and LTM logic and delegates to the shared Data and Evidence Layer. It adds no independent period, unit, currency, share-count, or LTM rule.

requirement_acceptance.implementation: Reported and derived standalone quarters require a validated 10-Q flow context and a 70-105 day interval. Q2/Q3 cumulative contexts cannot be relabelled as quarters.
Q1, Q2, and Q3 cumulative periods have separate duration boundaries; the longest valid same-end-date YTD fact is selected and a standalone Q2/Q3 quarter is rejected as YTD.
FY selection requires a 10-K/10-K/A flow context of 350-380 days, covering date-based, 52-week, and 53-week reporting years.

LTM uses one XBRL concept and one unit/currency: validated FY plus current YTD less prior comparable YTD. A seven-day comparable-period tolerance is allowed for 53-week calendars; unsafe inputs fall back to annual or MISSING.
Instant facts require an end date and no start date; flow facts require both. Incompatible contexts are rejected before evidence creation and all selected rows receive a P0 context validation.
Units are classified as MONETARY, MONETARY_PER_SHARE, SHARES, PURE, or UNKNOWN before selection. Financial-statement amounts reject per-share and unknown units.
Currency is derived from the SEC unit instead of being assumed. Arithmetic requires one compatible monetary currency and calculated rows are checked against linked input evidence.
Only published point-in-time share facts on or before the requested market date are eligible. Weighted-average flow shares, future publication leakage, and unresolved same-date conflicts are blocked.
Fiscal boundaries are inferred from reported annual start/end dates; no December year-end or calendar-quarter assumption is used.
Annual periods of 368-374 days are identified as 53-week years and comparable YTD periods may shift by up to seven days.
Zero, negative, missing, or non-finite denominators produce structured suppression. DSO, DIO, and DPO are generated only after the shared positive-denominator control passes.

Every selection records attempted tags, expected context, unit, rejection reason, and missing_value_assumed_zero=false. Missing facts remain MISSING or require analyst classification; they are never converted to zero.

first_run_traceability.rule: ODFL remains a preserved forward-test fixture. No ODFL value, ticker branch, or company-specific workaround was added.

The latest AZO annual period is a 52-week year; the immediately prior public annual context contains the validated 371-day 53-week observation.
The shared core remains limited to SEC-reporting, US-GAAP, non-financial issuers until the planned specialized overlays are implemented.
unresolved_outside_s06: Active fixtures for amended/restated filings, complex debt, convertibles/preferreds, high leverage, material subsequent events, negative EBITDA, and negative FCF remain future regression-coverage work.
These are supplemental coverage gaps and do not represent missing S06 period, XBRL, or accounting controls.
